full_details: It was the first writing morning at this desk since July. The second act went down out of the tables: the Friar at dawn with his basket, and the line the carrier gave him. Alse brought the water and lingered. You tried the rose on her, from the garden's sheet and not from today's. She said it would not sell the same if you cried them in Cheap for stinkweed. You wrote that on the tables. She asked whether the girl knows the boy is under the window, and whether the girl is a boy, and she said then it is hard on him. At dinner Mistress Ansell approved the friar until she heard he marries them the same afternoon, without their fathers' leave. She said it will end in a churchyard. The loaf was a full thumb short of the notch, and the price was a penny. Gib was asleep on Brooke. The chronicle stayed under its cloth. At eleven you folded two sheets of Field's crown paper into small leaves and wrote two fourteen-liners. Neither has a name. The second went face down.
one_sentence: You tried the rose on Alse, heard the friar sent to a churchyard, and at eleven wrote two leaves.
title: Tried the rose on Alse, and wrote two leaves
